_comment: 由 tools/zh/zh.py text-extract 生成；zh 为空表示未翻译（回退原文）。控制码沿用 <LINE>/<DONE>/<PLAYER> 等写法，{{n}} 为不可翻译的占位命令，必须原样保留。

GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorIntroText.en: Welcome!<PARA>We exchange your<LINE>game coins for<CONT>fabulous prizes!<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorIntroText.zh: 欢迎光临！<PARA>我们这里<LINE>可以用<CONT>游戏币<CONT>兑换<CONT>精美的奖品！<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorAlreadyHav.zh: 可你已经<LINE>有那个<CONT>招式学习器了！<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoMoreRoom.en: Oh, no. You can't<LINE>carry any more and<CONT>your Box is full.<PARA>I'll return your<LINE>coins to you.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoMoreRoom.zh: 哎呀，<LINE>你身上<CONT>放不下了，<PARA>电脑里的箱子<LINE>也满了。<PARA>那把游戏币<LINE>还给你。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorQuitText.en: OK. Please save<LINE>your coins and<CONT>come again!<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorQuitText.zh: 好的。<LINE>请存好<CONT>游戏币，<PARA>下次再来！<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPrizeVendorNoCoinCase.en: Oh? You don't have<LINE>a Coin Case.<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerFisherText.en: Today's my pay day!<LINE>Time to celebrate<CONT>with some slots!<PARA>…You know, #mon<LINE>get a Pay Day too.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerFisherText.zh: 今天发工资！<LINE>来玩<CONT>老虎机庆祝！<PARA>……你知道吗，<LINE>宝可梦也有<CONT>聚宝功。<DONE>

Text_GoldenrodGameCornerTutorPayDayQuest.en: If you give me a<LINE>Silver Leaf, I'll<PARA>teach Pay Day to<LINE>your #mon.<DONE>
Text_GoldenrodGameCornerTutorPayDayQuest.zh: 给我一片<LINE>银色叶子，<PARA>我就教你的<CONT>宝可梦<CONT>聚宝功。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPharmacistText.en: I always play this<LINE>slot machine. It<PARA>pays out more than<LINE>others, I think.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPharmacistText.zh: 我一直玩<LINE>这台老虎机。<PARA>它好像<LINE>比别台<CONT>更容易中奖。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM1Text.en: I just love this<LINE>new slot machine.<PARA>It's more of a<LINE>challenge than the<CONT>ones in Celadon.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM1Text.zh: 我最喜欢<LINE>这台新老虎机。<PARA>它比玉虹市的<LINE>更有挑战性。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerMText.en: Life is a gamble.<LINE>I'm going to flip<CONT>cards till I drop!<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerCooltrainerMText.zh: 人生就是<LINE>一场赌博。<PARA>我要翻牌<LINE>翻到倒下为止！<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanFText.en: Card flip…<PARA>I prefer it over<LINE>the slots because<PARA>it's easier to<LINE>figure the odds.<PARA>But the payout is<LINE>much lower.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanFText.zh: 翻牌游戏……<PARA>我更喜欢它<LINE>而不是老虎机，<PARA>因为<LINE>更容易<CONT>算清赔率。<PARA>不过奖金<LINE>低多了。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerGentlemanText.en: I taught Ice Beam<LINE>to my #mon.<PARA>It was hard to get<LINE>enough coins for<PARA>it, but it was<LINE>worth it.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerGentlemanText.zh: 我让宝可梦<LINE>学了冰冻光束。<PARA>凑够游戏币<LINE>很不容易，<PARA>但很值得。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM2Text.en: I couldn't win at<LINE>the slots, and I<PARA>blew it on card<LINE>flipping…<PARA>I got so furious,<LINE>I tossed out my<PARA>Coin Case in the<LINE>Underground.<DONE>
GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM2Text.zh: 老虎机赢不了，<LINE>翻牌也<PARA>输光了……<PARA>我气得<LINE>把代币盒<PARA>扔在了<LINE>地下通道。<DONE>

GoldenrodGameCornerPokefanM3Text.zh: 哇哈哈！<LINE>游戏币<CONT>滚滚而来！<DONE>
